title: Type 2 diabetes predicted effector genes (Rottner AK et al., 2023)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

A genome-wide CRISPR screen identifies CALCOCO2 as a regulator of beta cell function influencing type 2 diabetes risk.
Rottner AK et al.
Nat Genet. 2023 Jan;55(1):54-65. doi: 10.1038/s41588-022-01261-2.
PMID: 36543916

In this study, a genome-wide pooled CRISPR loss-of-function screen was performed in the human pancreatic EndoC-βH1 cell line and intracellular insulin content was measured. Among the 580 genes that were considered to be robust, reproducible screening hits, the 20 genes listed below were also represented in at least one of three lists of predicted effector genes on the Type 2 Diabetes Knowledge Portal: Type 2 diabetes predicted effector genes (Mahajan A and McCarthy MI 2019); Type 2 diabetes predicted effector genes - Effector index method (Forgetta V et al. 2022); and Type 2 diabetes predicted effector genes - Integrated Classifier method (Majarian T and Manning A 2020), lending support to the prediction that they are effectors for T2D.
